chunks: Abu Wallad al-Hannat said: I said to Abu Abd Allah, peace be upon him,

Indeed, when I entered al-Madinah, I had intended to stay there for ten days, so I performed the salat in full. Then it occurred to me not to stay there. So what do you think for me: should I perform in full or shorten?

He said to me: "If you entered al-Madinah and performed there one obligatory salat in full, then you may not shorten until you leave it. But if, when you entered it, you were upon your intention of completion, yet you had not performed there one obligatory salat in full before it occurred to you not to stay, then in that state you have the choice: if you wish, then intend residence for ten days and perform in full; and if you do not intend residence for ten days, then shorten for the period between you and one month. Then when a month has passed for you, perform the salat in full."

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: salat (prayer); the act whose legal form is under discussion
key_terms.الْمَدِينَةَ: al-Madinah; the place where the travel-residence ruling is being applied
key_terms.بِتَمَامٍ: in full; meaning performing the complete prayer rather than shortening it
key_terms.شَهْرٌ: one month; the duration after which the ruling changes to full prayer
key_terms.عَشْرًا: ten days; the threshold for intending residence and completing salat
key_terms.فَرِيضَةً: obligatory prayer; the ruling specifically concerns the obligatory salat
key_terms.فَقَصِّرْ: then shorten; meaning to perform the traveler's shortened prayer
key_terms.نَوَيْتُ: I intended; it indicates the legal significance of intention in determining the ruling

ai.seo_question: If a traveler intends to stay ten days and then changes his mind, should he perform full salat or shorten it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the salat of a traveler who initially intends to reside in al-Madinah for ten days and then changes that intention. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains that if one has already performed a single obligatory salat in full, one must continue full prayers until departure; otherwise, one may choose between renewing the ten-day intention or shortening until a month passes.
